items.title: My Talk at DEF CON
items.summary: Last month, I gave a talk at DEF CON on AI hacking: what happens when AIs become hackers. It’s a combination of the potentialities I raised in my 2022 book A Hacker’s Mind and the lessons we’re learning from current AI models engaging in hacking behavior. I’m really proud of the talk, and the fact that it gained over 100K views on YouTube in just a few days…

items.title: Cliff Stoll’s DEF CON Talk
items.summary: In August, Cliff Stoll gave a talk at DEF CON, remembering the wily hacker he stalked forty years ago. Great fun.

items.title: AIs Compress Exploit Timeline
items.summary: Give an AI agent a mere rumor of an exploit, and it’s enough for them to find it. What’s worse, I found I could use my own agents to find the exploit just by knowing roughly what it was about and so could have been exploiting it well before the public patch was available! items.title: Driver’s License Data for Sale
items.summary: A database of 153 million drivers licenses is for sale on the dark web. Brian Krebs has more detail .

items.title: Claude Fable Solves a Historical Cipher
items.summary: Claude Fable 5.1 solved a 370-year-old cipher in forty-four minutes. This tracks with what I wrote about AIs doing mathematics: It’s good at things that involve lots of searching and testing.
